mapper.select: select account_Id, user_no, inst_id, dept_id from t1000_account
SELECT INST_ID FROM T1000_ACCOUNT WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId}

select a.account_id as accountId, a.user_no as userNo, u.user_name as userName from t1000_account a join t1000_user u on a.user_no = u.user_no where (a.inst_id, a.dept_id) = (select a.inst_id, a.dept_id from t1000_account a where a.account_id = #{accountId}) and a.account_id != #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t1000_account (user_no, inst_id, dept_id, login_Id, password, account_status_cd) VALUES (#{userNo},#{instId}, #{deptId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, 'B002')
mapper.select: SELECT A.ACCOUNT_ID, U.USER_NO, A.INST_ID, A.DEPT_ID, A.LOGIN_ID, A.PASSWORD, A.CREATE_DT, A.UPDATE_DT, A.DEL_YN, A.CREATE_ID, A.UPDATE_ID, A.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CD, A.PWD_FAIL_CNT, A.PWD_CHANGE_DT, A.IS_SYSTEM, U.user_name FROM T1000_ACCOUNT A JOIN t1000_user U ON A.user_no = U.user_no WHERE A.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND A.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CD = 'B002' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
select a.account_id, a.login_id, u.user_name from t1000_account a join t1000_user u on u.user_no = a.user_no where a.dept_id=#{deptId} order by u.user_name
